new.title: Airtable sync
new.description: keep show dates in sync with an Airtable base, including session times, added or removed dates, and cancellations.

new.title: Guided Airtable setup
new.description: a step-by-step field-mapping screen links your programs and cities, automatically matching existing entries so you don't end up with duplicates.

new.title: Offer tier controls
new.description: producers and admins can open and close offer tiers directly.

new.title: Schedule-change notifications
new.description: the right people are alerted automatically when a date is cancelled or a session is added, removed, or re-timed.

improved.title: Redesigned login
improved.description: a new login page with a full-bleed hero image.

improved.title: Email branding
improved.description: transactional emails now consistently use the "ShowFlow" name.

new.title: Multiple organizations
new.description: shows, artists, and settings are isolated per organization, with a quick switcher for anyone who belongs to more than one.

new.title: Invite-only onboarding
new.description: invite teammates by email and have them join through a secure link. (Public sign-up has been retired.)

new.title: Your profile
new.description: a profile page with in-app password changes, plus a self-service password reset.

new.title: Member management
new.description: manage members and resend pending invitations.

new.title: Platform console
new.description: a super-admin console for managing organizations.

new.title: Cookie consent
new.description: a GDPR consent system with granular toggles for analytics, session replay, and error tracking. Tracking runs only if you opt in.

new.title: Legal pages
new.description: privacy policy and Impressum, available in English and German.

improved.title: Login feedback
improved.description: failed logins now show a clear inline error.

new.title: Automated offers
new.description: artists receive a daily digest of open offers with a response window; stale offers expire automatically, and a confirmation digest follows once they're booked.

new.title: Understudy auto-promotion
new.description: understudies are promoted automatically when a confirmed artist drops out.

new.title: Availability for producers
new.description: artist availability is surfaced to producers and feeds an auto-suggest booking engine.

improved.title: New design system
improved.description: a refreshed Showflow look across the app.

improved.title: Clearer bookings view
improved.description: a flatter, date-first layout; individual sessions replace start/end times; slot capacity is easier to read.

improved.title: Helpful table headers
improved.description: column descriptions now appear in table headers.

improved.title: Smarter availability
improved.description: the "block date" action is hidden once an artist already has a booking.

new.title: Cast editing
new.description: producers and admins can edit cast names and descriptions.
